records.subject: Welcome aboard, Harbor Labs
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Your workspace for Harbor Labs is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with zero customer replies to two outreach emails (email:c66bcc96, email:f0c7bfe0) and a no-show on the kickoff call (calendar:2b6a0903). No project, no invite, no tickets — no signal of engagement, so unaided activation in 8 days is unlikely.

draft.subject: Getting Harbor Labs' first project set up
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Sorry we missed each other last week — I know launch weeks get busy. Your Harbor Labs workspace is still ready whenever you are.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating one real project is the quickest way to see what it's for. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to work through that first project with you live, or just answer questions by email if that's easier.

Best,
Chidi
